ValidationRule.description: Retiring a product needs a date so quoting, renewals and reporting can all key off it.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR(ISPICKVAL(Launch_Stage__c, "End of Sale"), ISPICKVAL(Launch_Stage__c, "Retired")), ISBLANK(End_of_Sale_Date__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Set an End of Sale Date before moving a product to End of Sale or Retired.
